title: Dawn Blitz 2017 HIMARS USS Anchorage
description: U.S. Marines with Battery R, 5th Battalion, 11th Marine Regiment, 1st Marine Division, shoot a rocket from a High Mobility Artillery Rocket Systems (HIMARS) from the deck of the USS Anchorage striking a land-based target in support of Exercise Dawn Blitz, Oct. 22, 2017. Dawn Blitz is a scenario-driven amphibious exercise conducted between Expeditionary Strike Group 3 and 1st Marine Expeditionary Brigade, testing their ability to conduct amphibious operations in response to global crises and to project power ashore as part of a Navy-Marine Corps team. . (U.S. Marine Corps video by LCpl Victoria Decker)
